description: Election Commission - S. Sriranjan Elected as Chairman of the Poonakary P.S.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in the office of Chairman of the Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official to fill a vacancy, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
